data.content: Girona will play tomorrow at Montilivi against Almeria, in a challenging match against a solid team in good form. "It's a tough and complicated game, but I trust that we will give our best version," said coach Quique Álvarez, who emphasized the importance of winning: "The standings at the top are very tight, and we are coming off a loss. "They have gone nine games without losing and have players who can hurt you at any moment." Additionally, he pointed out that the upcoming series of matches, against mid-to-high table teams, will be a good measure to assess the team's situation. "Except for the match in Córdoba, what has hurt us the most has been the two red cards, against Castellón and Real Sociedad B."
